tasks.title: Draft PO for 100 t of oaten hay for Bowmans
Confirm Bowmans capacity and QC release for the Saigon Dairy order
Confirm carrier booking and 15 December ETA for Saigon Dairy
Check the 100 t purchase commitment against budget

final:
G-001 is short 100 t of oaten hay for Saigon Dairy Co.
Procurement will draft a PO for exactly 100 t for delivery to Bowmans by the 5 December cutoff.
Production will confirm capacity and QC release by 7 December, after procurement.
By 4 December, Sales Fulfilment will confirm the carrier booking and 15 December ETA, and Finance will check the purchase against budget.
The submitted plan awaits CEO approval.
